name: Calibre-Web
tagline: Web library for your Calibre ebooks
description: Browse, read and download your ebook collection in the browser. OPDS feed, format conversion (via Calibre binaries), user management.
compose:
services:
  calibre-web:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/calibre-web:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:8083"
    environment:
      PUID: "1000"
      PGID: "1000"
      TZ: "UTC"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/config
      - ${{cfg.library_dir}}:/books
    restart: unless-stopped
